|----------|----------------|
| How much gasoline (or diesel) does your car currently contain? | Determines the available energy reserve. |
| Do you know your vehicle’s fuel efficiency (e.g., miles per gallon)? | Needed to translate fuel volume into driving range. |
| Is there anything special about the terrain or traffic conditions expected en route? | Rough estimates often drop mileage under hilly or congested routes. |

If you don’t have exact numbers handy, even rough figures (like “about half full” or “roughly 15 mpg”) will allow us to compute an estimated maximum distance your car can still cover. Once we’ve got that, we can compare it against the ~750 mi round‑trip distance between Rivermist and Stonebrook and see if refueling would be necessary before departure. We could also request the user to provide current fuel level, mpg, etc. Or we might assume typical values. However best practice: Ask for clarification. Also mention we can calculate approximate range using average MPG and fuel tank size. So respond asking for those details.")
